description: All points are on longitude 0, so a straight line is the Earth's radius (6,371,008.8 m) times the difference of latitude in radians: 0.001 degrees is 111.19508 m, a walk of 111.19508 x 1.33 / 80 = 1.8486182 minutes. The place carries the links of its own cell: station 1 is 3.0 minutes away by them. But the place is 0.001 degrees from station 1, a straight walk of 1.8486182 minutes, which is quicker, so the way is 4 + 30 + 1.848618208877666 = 35.84861820887767, and not 4 + 30 + 3 = 37.
